# Scoryn

> AI-powered website audit tool that turns Google PageSpeed data into client-ready branded reports for agencies and freelancers.

Scoryn merges mobile and desktop PageSpeed audits into one clear dashboard, explains technical issues in plain business language, applies your agency branding, and exports a branded PDF or public share link that clients can open without an account.

Main site: https://www.scoryn.in

Key pages:
- How it works: https://www.scoryn.in/#how
- Pricing: https://www.scoryn.in/#pricing
- Privacy: https://www.scoryn.in/privacy
- Terms: https://www.scoryn.in/terms

Ideal for: web agencies, freelancers, and service businesses that audit client websites before a pitch, during cold outreach, or as ongoing monthly health reports.
